home.intro_heading: Furniture Born from Patience and Craft
home.intro_body1: Sons of Damascene is a family-run workshop in Kigali, Rwanda. We design and build custom beds, tables, chairs, storage and one-of-a-kind pieces—each one made with locally sourced timber and finished by hand.
home.intro_body2: Every piece starts with a conversation. Tell us what you have in mind, and we will bring it to life.
home.collage_materials_body: We work with sustainably harvested timber from Rwandan forests—mahogany, eucalyptus, pine and rosewood—chosen for grain, durability and warmth. No veneers. No shortcuts.
home.collage_cta_body: Browse our collection for inspiration, then get in touch on WhatsApp to start your custom order.
home.collage_process_body: Design. Craft. Finish. Deliver. Every step is handled in our Kigali workshop by the same hands that shaped the wood. We keep you informed from first sketch to final delivery.
home.banner_headline: The Perfect Balance of Craft and Comfort

about.title: About Sons of Damascene
about.heading: A Workshop Built on Patience
about.body1: Sons of Damascene was founded in Kigali with one purpose: to make furniture that lasts a lifetime. Our craftsmen learned their trade through years of practice, studying grain and joint and finish until they could produce work that tells a story.
about.body2: We believe that good furniture does not shout. It sits quietly in a room and grows more beautiful with age. We build to that standard, piece by piece.
about.value_craft_body: Every joint is hand-cut. Every surface is hand-finished. We do not rush.
about.value_durability_body: We use timber that will outlast trends and fashions. Our furniture is made to be handed down.
about.value_local_body: We source responsibly from Rwandan forests and certified suppliers, supporting the local ecosystem.

craftsman.title: Our Craftsman
craftsman.heading: Meet the Maker
craftsman.intro: The hands behind Sons of Damascene have shaped wood for over fifteen years. Born in Kigali, trained through apprenticeship and practice, our lead craftsman brings a quiet dedication to every piece that leaves the workshop.
craftsman.approach_body: Good furniture cannot be hurried. Our craftsman selects each board personally, checking grain and moisture before a single cut is made. The result is work that will still look beautiful decades from now.
craftsman.tools_body: Hand planes, chisels, mortise saws and draw knives sit alongside modern joinery tools. The combination gives us both precision and character. We finish with natural oils and waxes—nothing plastic, nothing synthetic.
